model.description: Single-year-of-age cohort-component model started from the State Demography Office (SDO) county forecast. With births, deaths and migration at 100% it reproduces SDO's population and households; each slider is a percentage of SDO's forecast.

base_population.source: SDO county forecast by single year of age and sex, Vintage 2024

death_rates.source: NCHS, U.S. State Life Tables, 2021, NVSR vol. 73 no. 7, Tables CO-2 and CO-3
death_rates.notes: Colorado's age pattern, scaled each year so each county's deaths equal SDO's forecast.

birth_rates.source: NCHS, Births: Final Data for 2023, NVSR vol. 74 no. 1, Table 8, Colorado
birth_rates.notes: Colorado's age pattern, scaled each year so each county's births equal SDO's forecast.

migration_by_age.notes: The change in SDO's population by age that births and deaths do not explain.

households.source: SDO household forecast by age of householder
households.notes: Households per person in four age groups, by year, applied to the scenario's people.

vacancy_target.notes: Each county's target vacancy, the one the HNA page uses.

place_share.source: data/hna/projections/places.json shares.blended; population share where a place has no ledger row
place_share.notes: The share of county growth the HNA page gives a town or CDP.

baseline.label: SDO forecast
baseline.notes: Reproduces SDO's forecast and the HNA page's 20-year figure.

low_growth.label: Half the migration
low_growth.attribution: COHO preset on the SDO forecast
low_growth.notes: Half SDO's net migration at every age.

high_growth.label: 1.5× the migration
high_growth.attribution: COHO preset on the SDO forecast
high_growth.notes: One and a half times SDO's net migration at every age.

widgets.label: Key numbers: homes needed by 2044, population, people moving in a year
widgets.source: SDO county forecast + cohort-component scenarios; in-commuter need from the ranking index
widgets.notes: At 100% the homes figure equals the HNA page's 20-year figure (test/scenario-baseline-reproduces-sdo.test.js).

widgets.label: Homes needed since 2024 for resident growth, 2024–2050 (line chart)
widgets.notes: Households added since 2024 ÷ (1 − county target vacancy), by scenario.

widgets.label: Year-by-year table
widgets.notes: Population, households added and homes needed for resident growth, by year and scenario.
